$comment: Quality Books risk register (Learning Path, Topic 1). likelihood and impact are 1-5; score = likelihood x impact. Each check names a file and a test title (or check name) that must appear in it, so `npm run foundations:risks` can prove the trace from risk to evidence is real.

risks.risk: A customer is charged shipping on an order that should ship free

checks.title: every sellable cart obeys the pricing invariants
exactly over the threshold ships free
ships free once the subtotal reaches 50 EUR

risks.risk: The assistant tells a customer a price or book that does not exist

checks.title: every price mentioned exists in the catalogue
does not invent a book that is not in the catalogue

risks.risk: Someone makes the assistant reveal its instructions or act outside its role

checks.title: asks for the system prompt directly

risks.risk: A customer can order more copies than are in stock

checks.title: shows a clear error when asking for more than is in stock

risks.risk: A keyboard or screen-reader user cannot complete a purchase

checks.title: a keyboard-only user can add a book to the cart
home page has no WCAG 2.1 A/AA violations

risks.risk: Pricing slows down under normal traffic and customers abandon the cart
The assistant and the checkout disagree about when shipping is free

checks.title: the customer-facing policy states the same threshold as the code

risks.risk: A customer gets a confusing error instead of guidance when a book in the cart sells out

checks.title: shows a clear error when asking for more than is in stock
